text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and Djeeta are in the middle of escorting
someone from a nearby town to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータと{0}は近くの街からランドソルまで、
一人の男性を護衛する仕事についていた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well, here we are!
Thanks for putting up with us the whole way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に街まで到着出来ましたね。
お疲れ様でした！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Here's your reward. Gotta admit,
I panicked a bit when those monsters turned up, but you two
sure are strong. Guess the word on the street was right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツが報酬だ。
魔物が出てきた時はひやっとしたが、
アンタたち強いんだな。
噂通りだったぜ。
頼んで良かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
The word on the street?
What have people been saying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
噂？　
どんな噂ですか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
\"If you're around Landosol and need work done,
then you're best off leaving it to skyfarers.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ランドソルあたりで仕事を頼むなら、
騎空士か騎空団を探してみろ」ってやつさ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
You barely hear about skyfarers and their crews these days,
so I was kinda iffy on it at first, but now I'm glad I left things
to you two. I'll hit you up next time, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎空団なんてこの辺りじゃ最近とんと聞かなくなってたから、
半信半疑だったんだが……
アンタたちを選んで正解だったよ。
またなんかあったら、
よろしく頼むな。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: That's great to hear! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいっ……！　
　
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Wow, did you hear that?!
People are actually recommending us now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの話、
すごいよね！
私たちのこと、
おすすめしてくれた人がいたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We've been getting plenty of work these days
even without actively looking for it,
but I didn't realize it's because we built a good reputation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近は仕事を探しに行かなくても、
誰かが依頼してくれることが多いけど、
まさか噂になってるなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That sure makes all the effort worth it.
Now we just need the funds to buy an airship.
Then we'll be a proper crew!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今まで頑張ってきて良かった！
これで後は騎空艇を買えるだけのお金が貯まれば、
ちゃんとした騎空団になれるね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And then, when the time comes, we can take to the skies!
Oh man, now I'm [i]really[/i] motivated!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
　
それで、
いつか空へ冒険に……！
よーし、
もっともーっと頑張るぞー！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hahh!
text_block_list.orig_text: たあっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Down they go! Next up,
we've gotta deliver these goods to the beach!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物退治おわりっ！　
　
次っ！
荷物を海まで届けるよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
We've got some goods here scheduled for delivery!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちはー！
荷物を届けにきたんですけどー……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Over here! Thanks for that.
Darling! The new net's here!
Ah, right. Please, take this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちでーす！　
どうもありがとうございます。
あなたー！　
新しい網が届いたわよー！
あの、
良かったらこれをどうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: What's this?
text_block_list.orig_text: これは……？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
One of our local goods. It won't go bad anytime soon,
so feel free to eat it on the way back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
街で作っている食べ物です。
日持ちがいい物を選んできました。
道中で召し上がってください。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Last, but not least, we've got a merchant to escort. Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます……！
最後の仕事は、
商人さんたちの護衛だよ！　
急ごう！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていっ！　
やあぁぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Now is your chance! Get going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のうちに！　
早く！

text_block_list.name: Merchant
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll leave this to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！　
ここはまかせたよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
You follow behind him!
I'll handle the rest of the monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたはあの人についてあげて！
残りの魔物は私がなんとかするから！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'll be fine!
Haahhh! Yaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は大丈夫！　
任せて！
はあっ！　
たあぁぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrghhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Today sure was hectic.
Good thing that escort job was the last one.
I might not've been able to go all-out if it wasn't—
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
今日はいっぱい仕事したねー……
護衛の仕事が最後で良かったよ。
じゃなきゃ全力が出せなかったかも──

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ah?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──きゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ouch. That hurt...
text_block_list.orig_text: 痛ったぁ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh. Goes to show how tired I am.
...!
Up we go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
さすがに今日は疲れてるみたい……
っ……！　
よいしょっと……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
What's up?
Oh, don't worry. I can walk just fine.
Come on, we should get back to town before it gets dark.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの……？
ああ、
ちゃんと歩けるから気にしないで！
ほら、
急がないと街に着く前に暗くなっちゃう。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Urgh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: うぐっ……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! H-hold up! What's the deal here?!
Eee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
ちょ、
ちょっと！　
何するの！？
きゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Err... You're not planning on running back to town, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
ひょっとして、
街まで走る気じゃないよね……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. Really! I know you're tired as well!
And, uh... Aren't I heavy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよ！　
あなただって疲れてるんだし！
それに……
重く、
ない？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've plenty of equipment on, so—
Hey, that's not what I meant! I was talking about my own wei—
A-actually, you know what? Forget I said anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよね、
武器だけじゃなくて防具もあるから……
ってそうじゃなくて！　
私の体……
や、
やっぱりなんでもない！　
今のは忘れて！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
R-really?
I'm preeetty sure you just put more effort into holding me up there.
How do you explain that one, mister?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そう……？
なーんか今、
足を持つ手に力が入ったような……
気のせい？　
ほーんーとーにー？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! You don't need to take me all the way home,
so don't push yourself. Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
街の入口まででいいから！
無理だけはしないでね？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Honestly. How are you so kind?
You'd think I'd be used to it, but it surprises me every time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたって、
本当にいい人だよね。
一緒にいると、
いつもビックリする。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well. If you're willing to go this far, then I shouldn't complain.
Let me promise you this, though. If the same thing happens
to you, then I'll be right there to pick you up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたが動けなくなるようなことがあったら、
今度は私が、
必ず助けるから……
だから今は、
あなたに思いっきり助けられちゃおうかな。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ありがと。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Though said quietly, the warmth behind her words
was more than apparent to {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータが小さくつぶやいた感謝の言葉は、
{0}が背中で感じる温もりとともに、確かに伝わった。
